newsitem.title: USA: Palmer sees Q2 oper cash flow growth.
newsitem.headline: Palmer sees Q2 oper cash flow growth.

text.p: Palmer Wireless Inc said Friday it expects to report second quarter subscriber and operating cash flow growth in line with analysts expectations.
Palmer said it expects to report operating cash flow for the quarter ending June 30 in the range of $20.5 to $21.5 million, an 18 percent to 24 percent increase over the $17.3 million a year earlier.

The company also said it expects 14,500 to 16,000 net subscriber additions for the second quarter, while total cellular subscribers at June 30 should be between 325,000 and 327,000, a one-third increase from a year ago.
Palmer said it expects to report full second quarter results on July 28.

Palmer Wireless owns and operates 18 non-wireline cellular telephone systems in Florida, Alabama, Georgia, and South Carolina covering a total estimated population of 3.9 million with over 325,000 subscribers.
